events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: English singer and songwriter Liam Gallagher, known as the frontman of Oasis and for his solo career, celebrates his 54th birthday.

angles.name: Liam's Legacy
angles.copy: Our Kid is another year older! Liam Gallagher, the unmistakable voice of Oasis, turns 54 today. What's your favourite Liam moment, musical or otherwise?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' album is 55
events.blurb: John Lennon's iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring his signature song, was released 55 years ago.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 55 years ago, John Lennon gave us 'Imagine'. A song that still resonates today, reminding us of the power of peace and unity. What does 'Imagine' mean to you?

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the revolutionary first iPod, which promised "1,000 songs in your pocket", 25 years ago.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the first time you put 1,000 songs in your pocket? The original Apple iPod was unveiled 25 years ago today, changing how we listened to music forever. What was the first song you loaded onto yours?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: Global James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Bond's Best
angles.copy: Grab your martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating 64 years since 'Dr. No' hit screens. Who's your favourite 007 and what's the best Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Influential Beatles co-founder, singer-songwriter, and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message of peace continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon lyric?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: The legendary English actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, co-founder of Monty Python and star of Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the one and only John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, his comedic genius is undeniable. What's your favourite John Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' is 58
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', was released 58 years ago.

angles.name: White Album Wonder
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles delivered their sprawling, experimental masterpiece, 'The White Album'. A bold statement that pushed boundaries. What's your standout track from this double LP?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury, 35 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 35 years since the passing of Freddie Mercury, the legendary frontman of Queen, known for his powerful vocals and flamboyant stage presence.

angles.name: Forever Freddie
angles.copy: Thirty-five years ago today, we lost an icon. Freddie Mercury's voice and showmanship remain unmatched. Join us in remembering the legendary Queen frontman. What's your favourite Freddie performance?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' is 61
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', featuring tracks like 'Norwegian Wood' and 'In My Life', 61 years ago.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Revolution
angles.copy: Sixty-one years since The Beatles took a bold step forward with 'Rubber Soul'. This album truly showcased their evolving artistry. What's your favourite track from this classic?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon, 46 years on
events.blurb: Today marks 46 years since the tragic death of John Lennon, the iconic co-founder of The Beatles and a powerful voice for peace.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy Lives
angles.copy: 46 years ago today, the world fell silent as we lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire hope and change. Remembering an irreplaceable legend.
